test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: While introducing a woman, Raman said, "She is the daughter-in-law of my grandfather's daughter-in-law". Which of the following could be the way in which the woman is related to Raman?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abf25944776d2a3ecedfc8ce453d6240c47cfde66b9c3a1ec4348e9237131af8.png] 

From the information given:

Step 1: She is the daughter-in-law 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9177ec982f1b9b02132fa1cc94f8a331ab34edb4a0abf42dbf6128ed3dc313d2.png] 

Step 2: my grandfather's daughter-in-law = my mother 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60925302d27fc01ebe3d54572bd7d216bf62b56668e0bc8c0b3143e737b41034.png] 

So the final diagram will be: She is the daughter-in-law of my grandfather's daughter-in-law

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/272ad08ba45391a9832605bd1330c5629f663fb6fd16268103504530727ed0b0.png] 

According to the given statement, there is a possibility that the lady could be the wife of Raman also but as per the given options, **the lady is Raman's brother's wife.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
